question: Should OpenClaw accept this signed marketplace feed refresh trust model and land it after the open predecessor PRs are resolved?
rationale: The code path is security and compatibility sensitive because it changes feed authenticity enforcement, config shape, Plugin SDK exported config types, and persisted snapshot trust state; automation cannot decide that product/security boundary while the branch is also conflicting and stacked.

options.title: Land after stack resolution
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316 first, then merge this PR if exact-head CI remains green.

options.title: Hold for trust-model review
options.body: Keep the branch open while maintainers review the RFC/security model and decide whether signed feed config should be accepted in core now.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want signed marketplace feed trust enforcement in the OpenClaw source repository yet.

recommendation.title: Land after stack resolution
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316 first, then merge this PR if exact-head CI remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee/reviewer and authored the substantive trust-boundary review and repair commits for this stack.
